whatIs: Flaticon is a bank of icons and stickers with more than 18 million assets, including general icons, interface icons, animated icons, and stickers. It has a search by terms, collections, and an editor to adjust colors before downloading.
It's a good fit when you need a one-off icon on a very specific topic and can't find it in the usual interface icon libraries.
uses: Finding a themed icon, such as a type of food or a sport, for a section of your site.
Building a collection of a project's icons to download them in a consistent style.
Downloading stickers for a presentation or a social media post.
caveats: With the free account you can only download PNG, and you have to give attribution: link to Flaticon and credit the author.
SVG, EPS, PSD, and Base64 formats, and use without attribution, require Premium.
Quality and style vary a lot between authors, so it's hard to keep a uniform set if you mix packs.
pricingNote: Free in PNG with attribution; Premium costs €9.99 per month or €89.99 per year, and taxes may apply.
idealFor: Finding specific themed icons for sites, presentations, or content.
